subject.description: A male fantasy character with a roguish and confident demeanor.

physical_features.facial_details: Slight facial scarring and a subtle, cocky smirk.

head.headgear: Deep red hooded cowl that completely obscures the face, adorned with a golden vertical line and crescent emblem

attire_and_gear.clothing: A dark maroon or brown tunic layered under a heavy, dark-colored cloak.
attire_and_gear.cape: Tattered red cape or cloak draped over the right shoulder.
attire_and_gear.armor: Leather bracers with cross-stitch detailing and a leather shoulder pauldron.
attire_and_gear.utility: A sturdy leather belt equipped with multiple small pouches and gear.
attire_and_gear.weaponry: A sharp dagger being balanced on a finger and another hilt visible at his hip.

composition.pose: The character stands with one hand on his hip, balancing a blade vertically on the tip of his index finger.
composition.art_style: Digital painting with studio-style lighting, soft shadows, and sharp metallic highlights.
